description:
Feature values for one instrument at one decision time.

The central invariant of the whole lab lives here:
``information_cutoff <= as_of``. ``as_of`` is the moment a decision is being
made; ``information_cutoff`` is the timestamp of the newest input that fed
these values. If the cutoff were allowed to exceed the decision time, the
features would encode the future and every downstream result would be
worthless. Constructing a violating snapshot raises.

as_of.description: Decision time these features are valid for.
as_of.title: As Of

computed_at.description: Wall-clock time the snapshot was computed.
computed_at.title: Computed At

information_cutoff.description: Timestamp of the newest input used. Must not exceed as_of.
information_cutoff.title: Information Cutoff

schema_version.description: Contract version this record was written under.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

values.description: Feature name to value. None marks a legitimately missing value.
values.title: Values

title: FeatureSnapshot
